heading: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise up to 1% as oil falls; Trump-Xi summit in focus
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: US futures rose on Monday as oil fell for a fourth day and Bessent called US-China talks ‘successful’. Xi visits the US Sept 23-25 for talks with Trump on trade and AI. Markets also watch the Fed's rate hike, BOJ tightening, and possible Trump-Pezeshkian talks amid Middle East tensions.
